notes.title: Updates/Fixes from 26 September 2016
notes.content:
26 September 2016


Hello everyone.
We bring you a major update of the Second Warfare.

Please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the Discussions area of the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/372740/discussions/] Community Hub[/url] .

[h1]New features/Gameplay tweaks:[/h1]
1. The latest version of the game engine Unity 5.4.1.
2. Improved graphics.
3. The optimization of the game.
4. Fix bugs.
5. Brand new artificial intelligence soldiers.
6. Added a new map and mission.
7. Reworked missions and maps in the game.

Thank you to everyone who supports us.

notes.title: Updates/Fixes from 3 July 2015
notes.content:
3 July 2015


Hello everyone.
Throughout the week we worked on optimizing the game and fixing bugs.

Please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the Discussions area of the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/372740/discussions/] Community Hub[/url] .

[h1]New features/Gameplay tweaks:[/h1]
1. Optimization of the game.
2. Fix bugs.
3. Added tracers when firing the assault rifle.
4. A bunker of sandbags replaced by a brick bunker with a camera and a soldier inside.
5. Lantern light is configured so that at low settings is not scattered by all objects.
6. To switch the flashlight on the gun to press F or L.
7. The main weapon of the main character now an assault rifle.
8. Added support for Mac OS X SteamOS + Linux.

Thank you to everyone who supports us.

notes.title: Welcome to Second Warfare Early Access
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to the Second Warfare Early access.

We are launching a Second Warfare on Steam.

Please make sure to visit the forum and give us feedback.

Good luck.

notes.title: Second Warfare Private Alpha in Full Swing
notes.content:
Hi everyone and thank you for participating in the Second Warfare Private Alpha! 

[h1]Find opponents in the official group[/h1]
If you're having trouble finding players, please join the official [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/372740]Second Warfare[/url] Steam Group - and add other members as friends to invite into a game. 

[h1]The purpose of the alpha test - find bugs[/h1]
If you find any bug, please report it on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/372740/discussions/]forum[/url].

[h1]Suggest your ideas for the game![/h1]
If you have any idea for the Second Warfare, report it on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/372740/discussions/]forum[/url].
All the ideas we take to examining.

Thank you for being with us, Kobra Studio.
